mapper.select: SELECT BILL_ID, BILL_NUMBER, BILL_TYPE, BILL_AMOUNT, CURRENCY, ISSUE_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, DRAWER_NAME, DRAWER_ACCOUNT, PAYEE_NAME, PAYEE_ACCOUNT, ACCEPTOR_NAME, ACCEPTING_BANK, BILL_STATUS, BILL_PURPOSE, BILL_SOURCE, STORAGE_LOCATION, REGISTRAR_ID, REGISTRAR_NAME, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_BY, COMPANY_ID, DEPT_ID FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE BILL_ID = #{billId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
SELECT * FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE BILL_NUMBER = #{billNumber} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION SET DELETE_FLAG = 1 WHERE BILL_ID IN
#{billId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(AVG(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS avgAmount, COALESCE(MAX(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS maxAmount, COALESCE(MIN(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS minAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN BILL_STATUS IN ('NORMAL', 'VALID', 'ACTIVE', 'HOLDING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS activeCount FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
SELECT BILL_TYPE AS billType, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS amount FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY BILL_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT BILL_STATUS AS billStatus, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS amount FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY BILL_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT ACCEPTING_BANK AS acceptingBank, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS amount FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ACCEPTING_BANK IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ACCEPTING_BANK ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN BILL_AMOUNT < 100000 THEN '10万以下' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 100000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 500000 THEN '10-50万' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 500000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 1000000 THEN '50-100万' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 1000000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 5000000 THEN '100-500万' ELSE '500万以上' END AS amountRange, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS amount FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN BILL_AMOUNT < 100000 THEN '10万以下' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 100000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 500000 THEN '10-50万' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 500000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 1000000 THEN '50-100万' WHEN BILL_AMOUNT >= 1000000 AND BILL_AMOUNT < 5000000 THEN '100-500万' ELSE '500万以上' END ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS totalAmount FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CREATE_TIME >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AND CREATE_TIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS totalAmount FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND CREATE_TIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')

SELECT
BILL_TYPE AS category,
BILL_STATUS AS category,
ACCEPTING_BANK AS category,
BILL_TYPE AS category,
COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS amount, COALESCE(AVG(BILL_AMOUNT), 0) AS avgAmount FROM TBL_BILL_REGISTRATION WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
AND CREATE_TIME >= #{startDate}
AND CREATE_TIME <= #{endDate}
AND BILL_TYPE IN
#{type}
AND BILL_STATUS IN
#{status}

BILL_TYPE BILL_STATUS ACCEPTING_BANK BILL_TYPE
